channel.title: Foundation for Freedom Online (FFO) – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Foundation for Freedom Online (FFO) – Bias and Credibility (foundationforfreedomonline.com)

item.title: UK Prime Minister Announces VPN Regulations to Enforce Censorship Laws - Foundation for Freedom Online
item.description: Keir Starmer, the embattled UK Prime Minister, wants to join the small club of authoritarian nations that enforce restrictions on VPNs.

item.title: Transatlantic Censorship Architect Morgan McSweeney Ousted Over Epstein Scandal - Foundation for Freedom Online
item.description: Morgan McSweeney, formerly the top aide to UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer, has resigned amid mounting scandal over the Epstein Files.

item.title: German Chancellor Calls for End to Online Anonymity - Foundation for Freedom Online
item.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has publicly said he wants to see people use their real names when participating online.

item.title: How NED Used American Tax Dollars to Target President Trump - Foundation for Freedom Online
item.description: The National Endowment for Democracy (NED), recently approved for funding with Republican support, previously targeted Republicans.

item.title: Colorado Lawmakers Seek Device-Level Digital ID - Foundation for Freedom Online
item.description: The sudden push for age verification in states and countries around the world risks de-anonymizing the internet.

item.title: Global and Domestic Push for Digital ID Gathers Momentum - Foundation for Freedom Online
item.description: Age verification laws increasingly require users to risk de-anonymization by uploading identity documents online.

item.title: UK Government Seeks Powers to Expand Online Censorship Without a Vote - Foundation for Freedom Online
item.description: Already infamous for its tight restrictions on political speech, the UK government is seeking further online censorship powers.

item.title: 'Civil Society' Takes Credit For Role in $140M EU Fine Against X - Foundation for Freedom Online
item.description: The EU DisinfoLab credited civil society for providing the evidence used by the European Commission to issue its $140m fine against X.

item.title: Over 400 Cybersecurity and Privacy Experts Warn of Digital ID Threat to Internet Security - Foundation for Freedom Online
item.description: Age verification laws in the US and around the world present a growing risk to anonymous online speech, warn experts.

item.title: Meta and TikTok Drop End-to-End Encryption for Private Messages - Foundation for Freedom Online
item.description: Tech companies are being pressured by regulators around the world to abandon end-to-end encryption tech that guarantees user privacy.
